description: Context loading validation — verify all identity files were read

rules.name: identity_files_loaded
rules.reason: SYSTEM.md and identity files must be loaded
rules.retry_instruction: Step-01 output is missing the 'files_loaded' field. Re-execute step-01 to load SYSTEM.md, CLAUDE.md, and all identity files, then populate this field with a list of successfully loaded files.

rules.name: no_critical_missing_files
rules.reason: Track which identity files are missing (some may be optional)
rules.retry_instruction: The 'missing_files' field is missing. Re-execute step-01 and populate this field with a list of expected files that were not found (or empty list if all critical files loaded).
